verdict.reasoning: Patient states a “very sort of bad, severe headache, the past four days” and says “I’ve been sort of feeling a bit hot as well… I’ve got a bit of a temperature, I think… I think I’ve got a fever,” which supports severe headache for 4 days and feeling febrile.
When asked what started first, patient says: “headache started uh, first. Um, and then sort of yeah, fever sort of came along a bit afterwards,” confirming the headache preceded the fever.
Patient reports: “I’ve had some Paracetamol and some Ibuprofen, but it’s not really helping at the moment,” indicating poor relief from both medications.
When asked if light is difficult to look at, patient initially says “Yep” then clarifies: “Um no, like um it, it’s fine, light doesn’t seem to bother me too much,” which is a denial of photophobia.
Patient says: “I’ve got some general aching muscles… It’s kind of a bit all over, really” and later “just, I, I suppose general aching, body aching,” consistent with generalized myalgias.

Neck pain: patient mentions general muscle aching “not necessarily sort of in my neck”; nausea/vomiting: to “have you been sick with this headache?” patient answers “No, no I haven’t”; cough/coryza: to “do you have a cough?” and “so there’s no cough or cold, yeah?” patient answers “no”; ear pain: to “there’s no earaches?” patient says “no… it’s fine.” This supports denial of neck-specific pain, vomiting, cough, cold, and ear pain.
To “do you have any kind of shivering at all?” patient answers: “I do feel cold quite a lot… no sort of shivering, but definitely like a bit cold,” indicating feeling cold without shivers.

Rash: patient says “I mean I’ve got a bit of a rash…”; location: “the rash is kind of all over my body”; character: “sort of red and itchy”; blanching: to “if you were to put a glass on top of the rash, does that rash go away?” patient says “Yes… It goes away.” This supports diffuse red itchy, blanching rash.

Patient notes: “a friend of mine has also been a bit unwell,” which supports that the travel companion is unwell.

Same sentence: “I’ve had some Paracetamol and some Ibuprofen, but it’s not really helping at the moment,” confirms ibuprofen use.
To “any allergies at all?” patient responds “Uh, no,” which supports no known drug allergies.
